item.title: Flights Grounded Across US Over Air Traffic Control Problems
item.description:
Nov 13th, 2026
Flights Grounded Across US Over Air Traffic Control Problems
US authorities halted flights nationwide due to communication issues affecting air traffic control, an extraordinary action that threatens to disrupt travel across the globe. The Federal Aviation Administration said in an advisory notice on its website on Friday that the ground stop affects all US airports and departing flights should remain grounded until further notice. It cited “extraordinary circumstances” and “reasons of safety.” Bloomberg Intelligence Global Head Aerospace, Defense & Airline Analysis reacts to the ongoing situation saying the ground stop is about de-conflicting traffic.

item.title: US is Struggling to Build Affordable Housing
item.description:
BusinessWeek Radio Simulcast • Nov 13th, 2026
US is Struggling to Build Affordable Housing
America’s housing affordability crisis may be about more than high mortgage rates and restrictive zoning. Boston Fed Principal Economist and Policy Advisor Paul Willen says soaring construction costs are making many new housing projects financially unworkable, even after they’ve already won approval. He points to research showing construction productivity has barely improved in decades, even as productivity across much of the rest of the economy has surged.

item.title: Salim Ramji on the Vanguard Effect
item.description: Barry speaks with Vanguard CEO Salim Ramji. They discuss his early career journey in law before transitioning to BlackRock as Head of Corporate Strategy and later taking over as the first "outsider" CEO of Vanguard. They also discuss Vanguard's recent acquisition of Altruist and what it means for the future of financial advice. (Source: Bloomberg)
